question: Find the display names of users who own posts that have both the highest favorite count among all posts and more comments than the average number of comments across all posts.

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_055"
FROM users AS T1
INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1."XCL_052" = T2."XCL_033"
WHERE T2."XCL_039" = (SELECT MAX("XCL_039") FROM posts)
  AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments AS C WHERE C."XCL_006" = T2."XCL_026")
      > (SELECT AVG(cc) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cc FROM comments GROUP BY "XCL_006"))
